autotelic.definition: a. of or relating to or believing in autotelism

autotelism.translation: 艺术创作有其自身的目的

autotetraploid.translation: n. 同源四倍体(由二倍体生物的自身染色体组重复形成)

autothermic cracking.translation: [化] 自裂解; 自热裂化; 氧化裂化

autothreading.translation: [计] 自动穿带, 自动引带

autothrottle.translation: 自动节流活门, 自动油门

autotomic.definition: a of or relating to autotomy
autotomic.translation: 自断的, 自作手术的, 自身分裂的

autotomise.definition: v cause a body part to undergo autotomy

autotomize.definition: v cause a body part to undergo autotomy
autotomize.translation: v. 自割, 自行分裂

autotomized.definition: v cause a body part to undergo autotomy
autotomized.translation: v. 自割, 自行分裂( autotomize的过去式和过去分词 )

autotomizes.definition: v cause a body part to undergo autotomy
autotomizes.translation: v. 自割, 自行分裂（autotomize的第三人称单数形式）

autotomizing.definition: v cause a body part to undergo autotomy
autotomizing.translation: v. 自割, 自行分裂( autotomize的现在分词 )

autotomy.definition: n. spontaneous removal or casting off of a body part (as the tail of a lizard or claw of a lobster) especially when the organism is injured or under attack
autotomy.translation:
n. 自割
[医] 自身分裂; 自作手术; 自断, 自切(动物体)

autotoxin.translation:
n. 自体毒素
[医] 自体毒素

autotrace.translation: 电气-液压靠模仿型铣床

autotracking.translation: [计] 自动跟踪, 自动位置对准

autotransductor.translation: 自耦磁放大器, 自饱合电抗器

autotransformer.translation:
n. 自耦变压器
[医] 自耦变压器, 单卷变压器

autotransfusion.translation: n. (将病人的血存储起来在手术时输回其体内的)自体输血法

autotransplantation.translation:
n. 自体移植
[医] 自体移植[法]

autotroph.definition: n plant capable of synthesizing its own food from simple organic substances
autotroph.translation: n. [生]自养生物,靠无机物质生存的生物

autotrophic.definition: a of or relating to organisms (as green plants) that can make complex organic nutritive compounds from simple inorganic sources by photosynthesis
autotrophic.translation: a. 自造营养物质的, 自给营养的

autotrophs.translation: n. [生物] 自养生物（autotroph的复数）

autotune.translation: 自动调谐, 自动统调

autotype.definition: n. process for producing permanent prints in a carbon pigment
autotype.translation:
n. 摹真本, 碳印法, 碳印法的相片
vt. 用碳印法印

autotypic.definition: a of or relating to autotypy

autotypy.definition: n. The art or process of making autotypes.
autotypy.translation: n. 复写；碳印法；单色版 (autotype的变形)
